I've been playing this game for about 7 years now and it has not let me down since! The "hours played" might look low but that's because i use to play it on a different account. 

What i like about this game:
- The ocean liner mods for this game are top tier and no other simulation games can beat this!
- The water, waves and weather settings are so interesting 
- Scenery mods and in game maps are so nostalgic that they never get boring
- When you have free time and can't think of another game to play, playing this and role playing whilst listening to music is absolute gold!

I did hear about the news of developer Ilan Papini and i always wonder why i didn't get any notifications at all about it. All of the games that he has made will live on forever, these games may no longer be updated but that makes it more unique and proves that sometimes, things can change but some can't. I will still play his game in his honour and i won't regret it! This game has cheered me up many many times and i thank Ilan Papini for the work he has put into what he has created, amazing actual fun games!

All the best to you all, the VSF community <3
